scoring_justification: The checker independently recomputes the field-induced shear modulus ΔG from the agent's raw results.csv using the same model (direct dipole summation) and compares values within tolerances; it also verifies monotonicity trends, both fully recomputed without trusting the agent's self-reported metrics.

outputs.description: Field-induced shear modulus ΔG computed from the Gaussian distribution model for the specified parameter sweeps. The checker will recompute ΔG independently and compare values within predefined tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The agent must implement the complete model as described in the workflow steps. All input constants are public and no external data are required.

steps.tolerance_desc: relative 5% for ΔG >= 0.2 MPa, absolute 0.02 MPa for ΔG < 0.2 MPa; linear decay beyond tolerance
steps.notes: Recomputes ΔG for every row using independent model implementation and compares to agent's reported Delta_G column.
Verifies monotonicity trends: ΔG increases with L, decreases with b, increases with H0, decreases with γ.
